text:
incident-bot: SEV2 pager: increased tail latency on /v1/generate for hosted region eu-west-1. Errors 5xx ~1.8% over last 15m. Pager: @jess (oncall)

jess: Ack — jumping in. any known deploys?
nate: Not that I see. CI shows no recent model pushes.
maria: Noticed increased queueing on GPU pool redwood-eu-3 around 12:14UTC, KV cache spikes.
jess: OK moving to mitigation: scaled dedicated pool +1 replica, flipped routing to eu-west-2 for non-PII customers.
lee: Nice. What about customers with pinned region?
jess: Pinned users will see degraded latency. Estimating ~2% of active sessions impacted. tagging product-ops for comms. @product-ops
product-ops: thanks — we'll draft a short note once we confirm scope. pls add affected customer IDs.
ryan: Early root guess: kvcache eviction thrash due to recent embedder TTL change (deployed 2 days ago).
devex: I saw that change in config: `embedder.ttl_seconds = 30` -> 10. Could cause churn.
jess: Good find. For live mitigation: reverting TTL to 30s on redwood-eu-3 config now.
incident-bot: action created: INC-4821 "Investigate embedder TTL regression" owner: @nate severity: P1 (live)
nate: I'm on it. Will instrument more KV eviction metrics + correlate with tail lat. ETA 2h.
maria: I'll roll back embedder TTL in canary then region if metrics clear.
jess: Please post short results here. If rollback doesn't help, next step is gating requests to smaller batch sizes.
product-ops: Scheduling a brief customer note after we confirm rollback effect. prefer 1 sentence + link to postmortem.
lee: For post-incident: recommend postmortem and 3 action items: 1) Revert TTL config and add canary guard 2) Add kvcache alert for eviction rate 3) Run load test with new embedder TTL values.
ryan: Agree. Also add an optimization task: evaluate TTL heuristics per model class.
nate: Quick sizing: Revert + canary guard = small (2 engineer-hours). kvcache alert = small (4h including dashboards). Load test + eval = medium (2-3 engineer-days). TTL heuristics research = large (2+ sprints).
jess: Adding owners: revert -> maria, alert -> lee, load test -> nate, heuristics -> ryan.
incident-bot: created postmortem stub: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-4821 (owner: @jess)
devex: Can we schedule postmortem sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC? seems urgent to slot before planning.
product-ops: Put it on Q2 reliability board as "embedder-ttl mitigation" and tag as priority for OKR linking.
maria: Rollback complete on canary at 12:42UTC, metrics trending down: 5xx -> 0.4%, p95 latency dropping. Rolling region at 12:55UTC.
jess: Great. Confirming customer impact: 2% of sessions with pinned eu-west-1, about 3 customers with high-traffic SLAs saw tail latency >1.5s for ~30m. Recommend targeted follow-up for those customers.
product-ops: Noted — we'll prepare outreach. small customer credits may be needed depending on postmortem.
nate: Investigations ongoing. I will open subtask tickets with instrumentation links.
lee: I'll create alert runbook + pager thresholds. estimated 6h total.
ryan: Moving heuristics to roadmap backlog — will propose a scoped spike for next sprint.
jess: Closing live mitigation: status -> mitigated, next -> postmortem + action items assigned. Thanks everyone. :tada: 
incident-bot: incident status updated to "mitigated"; postmortem meeting scheduled 2024-05-03T09:30:00Z; follow-ups: INC-4821-1 (revert), INC-4821-2 (alert), INC-4821-3 (load test), INC-4821-4 (heuristics spike).
